rank_method: Competition ranking by equally weighted mean across Aegyptus, Thracia, Germania; ties within 0.000001 share rank, subsequent ranks have gaps.

settings.technologies: all imported minus disabled legacy technologies
settings.provinces: independent scenarios with one owned capital each

burgundian_condition.description: Harsh Sustenance enabled at fertility 1 (Meagre, below Poor=2)

limitations: Same incomplete verified building catalog as the fertility-5 benchmark; no full-campaign ranking. Huns and White Huns excluded. Burgundian curing buildings remain outside the priced catalog.
status: All 162 compared faction/province/level cases have model optimality proofs; 3 additional Burgundian baseline cases are retained in the source artifacts.
